Application links an OAuth2 client record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界).

Application links a SAML service provider record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界).

Application links a WS-Federation relying party record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界).

IdManagement records the CSV import audit event in the same transaction that commits the user or group import, so a committed import cannot lack its audit record (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界).

IdManagement writes the password history of a password set by user CSV import in the same transaction that commits the imported user, so reuse checks cannot miss an imported password (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界).

IdManagement enqueues the group reconcile job in the same transaction that commits the group CSV import, so a committed import cannot lack its reconciliation (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界).
